replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
Hey there,

I highly appreciate you admitting to hacking. But since you did infact break the rules, I'll have to keep your punishment as it is. Try appealing in 5-8 months. And your infraction may possibly get appealed. Keep in mind, ban evasion is not a way to go. And if you do, there will be a 0% chance of you getting unbanned.


Regards, Josh/Acceqted

I'll leave this open for 24 hours if you have anything to say.
